title: Add backup and restore verification path
description: Make backup and restore a tested, safe part of update and recovery rather than an unverified tar command.
acceptanceCriteria: Backup includes the required database/config/runtime metadata and excludes transient logs where documented
Backup creation checkpoints SQLite when applicable and reports a verifiable archive checksum
Restore validates archive paths/content, preserves permissions, and can restore into a temporary fixture
Update/rollback automatically verifies that the required backup exists before changing the active release
Tests cover successful backup/restore, missing/corrupt archive, and path traversal rejection

steps.description: Use temporary data directories to test archive contents, checksum, corrupt archive, missing database, and traversal entries.
Read `scripts/backup.sh`, installer backup/rollback, database URL resolution, and docs; record exact data paths and permissions.
Add validation/checksum/report metadata and safe extraction while preserving existing backup location/CLI compatibility.
Run focused backup/restore tests and an update/rollback fixture; do not touch production data.

technicalNotes: Never commit `.data`, databases, keys, or backups. Treat real backup files as sensitive even if SQLite is intended to be encrypted at rest.
